correctness.rationale: For fixed A in M2(Fq), the linear map B↦AB+BA has rank 0 for A=0, 2 for nonzero trace-zero A, 3 for singular nonzero-trace A, and 4 for invertible nonzero-trace A. A=t(I−P) reduces rank-three image membership to tr(PC)=0; counting rank-one projections by their image line yields M(C)=q+1−e(C)+qz(C). Adding the four disjoint contributions proves each scalar and nonscalar fiber formula; standard similarity centralizer sizes give five nonzero nonscalar populations. Independently enumerated all 3^8 and 5^8 ordered pairs and every target, reproducing seven distinct values and total mass q^8.
